verdict.rationale: Gumloop's API and SDKs cover a meaningful set of core resources. You can create and update agents, run sessions with streaming, use chat completions, and the Python client spans agents, sessions, MCP, skills, artifacts and teams. Webhook triggers can also run agents over HTTP. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity: API keys are generated in the Connectors UI, and configuration surfaces such as scheduled and app triggers, human-in-the-loop approvals, connectors, access roles and performance metrics show no API equivalent. The OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API endpoints for triggers, connectors, approval settings, access roles and performance data, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
